title: A Short Analysis of the Low-Temperature Structure and Physico-Mechanical Properties of PMDA–ODA Polyimide
content: Based on classical concepts of the chemistry and structure of polyimide compounds, a microscopic model of intramolecular mobility in technical Kapton has been proposed. This model provides a comprehensive explanation for the full set of observed low‑temperature physico‑mechanical characteristics of the material. The comprehensive analysis of experimental data and the derived geometric, energetic, and kinetic parameters confirm the robustness of the proposed model.
